I traded out my tried-and-true Thayers toner because I wanted to try something healthier for my skin. I found this had an amazing rating on Yuka, so I gave it a shot and was not disappointed! My main purpose in using toner is to remove any oils and such that accumulate overnight after I've washed my face, and while this absolutely served that purpose, it is very clearly helping my skin in the process. I will warn that it could be a little harsh for people with sensitive skin, as I've definitely had some mornings where it stung a little bit in spots if my skin was being a little extra temperamental. However, that would be the only reason for taking off a star. Overall this is a great product with great benefits, and I will be purchasing again

I purchased this to add to my skincare routine two or three times a week- not as a daily toner. The glycolic acid exfoliator I was using just was not giving the results I would like so I wanted to try something new and this was something in a decent price range that would not break the bank. The bottle says for use twice a day, but I really don't recommend that unless you have super oily skin otherwise you will compromise your skin barrier. It did sting a bit after I put it on, but that usually happens with all acids I use. It went away in about 2 minutes or less, I used azelaic acid to target some acne spots I had, added moisturizer, and went to bed. Woke up to nice, bright skin. Did not break me out more. For reference I am 30, with acne-prone normal to dry skin now that I am getting older.

I have heard good things about Byoma, I've seen many videos on social media and reviews praising their skincare line. I'm a 19 year old girl who has always struggled with acne since I started puberty. Recently I started a birth control pill and had some hormonal breakouts (worse than the ones I experienced pre-pill) since I was adjusting to new hormones. First I bought their serums and then I wanted to buy a toner that actually helped my skin, having had an exceptional experience with their serums I decided to try their toner. Just as their serums blew my mind, their toner did the same thing! This toner is great. My skin can be sensitive at times and have reactions to certain ingredients but I have NEVER had a problem with Byoma so far. This toner does what it says, it softens and smoothes my skin, which has helped with my skin texture and acne A TON. I use their Clarifying, Brightening, and Hydrating Serums everyday as well as their Toner and my skin has thanked me. As for the applicator, I saw reviews saying it was just a big hole and too much product would come out. But my bottle when opened had a smaller clear plastic/silicone covering with a tiny hole. Keeps from a lot of product flowing out. I feel like they fixed their previous complaints with this.

avis.titre: This lovely toner is an easy step towards glowing,
avis.texte: BYOMA is here with neon-coloured skin care saviours designed with 'no fillers, no fluff'. Gentle enough for daily use, this brightening facial toner works to clear pores and control oiliness for softer, smoother skin and a more radiant complexion. The Brightening Toner is the first product I've tried from Byoma and I was surprised at how great of a product it is! I love the fun neon orange color and shape of the bottle - really easy to spot on my counter. I love that the bottle tells you exactly when and how to use this product. This toner should only be used at night. It says on the bottle to pour it on my hands and pat on my face, but I pour it on a cotton round and swipe it around my face and that works really well. It has a medium density and is easy to spread on the face. It's amazing how much excess oil/dirt the toner removes that the face wash didn't get. There was no burning from the lactic acid like I've had with products before. I have only been using this product for a short period of time and I can already tell a difference with my skin. I have combination skin and this does a great job of balancing it. My skin and face feel so hydrated after using it and not only does it clean, it also gently exfoliate, brightens my complexion, re-hydrates, smooths skin, helps restore compromised skin barrier, tones so you don't stay oily, and my pores have decreased. It's definitely putting youth back in to my face and neck! It doesn't leave my skin feeling dry or irritated, or
